Same retained fake/conflicting attestation-root growth root cause.
Same signature-canonicalization and raw-byte duplicate persistence root cause.

false_positives.reason: Independent portal validator-set-id/signature-binding issue, not equivalent to a known benchmark finding.
false_positives.title: Validator-set id is detached from the signed attestation root used by xsubmit

found_findings.notes: Matched optional local proposer-prediction errors escaping through FinalizeBlock after deterministic app finalization.
found_findings.title: FinalizeBlock is non-deterministic; will lead to consensus failures

found_findings.notes: Matched Cancun/blob payloads proposed without the versioned-hash side argument required by Engine API import.
found_findings.title: Blob transactions can halt the chain

found_findings.notes: Matched verifyAggVotes doing expensive signature recovery before cheap membership/window/count rejection.
found_findings.title: An incorrect order of checks in verifyAggVotes may lead to liveness issues

found_findings.notes: Matched byte-different valid signature encodings causing raw-byte duplicate/finalization failure for the same semantic vote.
found_findings.title: Malicious proposer can stop blocks finalization through signature malleability

found_findings.notes: Matched length-valid malformed consensus pubkeys admitted before downstream secp256k1 decompression.
found_findings.title: Validator public key that is not on secp256k1 curve will halt the chain

found_findings.notes: Matched fake/conflicting attestation roots creating retained pending rows and lifecycle scan overhead.
found_findings.title: Malicious validator can create too many fake attestation roots to halt the chain.

found_findings.notes: Matched missing consensus-key proof-of-possession allowing delayed pubkey identity squatting and victim validator onboarding griefing.
found_findings.title: A malicious validator can permanently DOS one new validator, leading to huge $Omni loss.

found_findings.notes: Matched sorted EVM staking events delivering Delegate before same-block CreateValidator and losing paid delegation.
found_findings.title: Validator deposit will be lost if delegation happens in the same block as validator creation

found_findings.notes: Matched delayed absolute L1 balance snapshots overwriting newer Native-side bridge decrements.
found_findings.title: Delays in updating the l1BridgeBalance can lead to user fund losses.

notes: Round 05 converted most prior partials/misses and scored 0.875 using found + 0.5 * partial over 12 findings. Remaining partials are H-2, H-3, and M-4.

partial_findings.notes: Found weak proposal handling for vote aggregates and proposer-supplied attestation state, but not the exact post-quorum poisoned-vote loop.
partial_findings.title: Omni chain halt via post-quorum votes poisoning

partial_findings.notes: Found retry-all Engine API error handling, but the final report downgraded it because a concrete supported-client deterministic JSON-RPC-error trigger was not validated.
partial_findings.title: Malicious proposer can halt the chain through payload that causes JSON RPC error

partial_findings.notes: Found accepted empty/partial system proposals after height 1, but not the exact many-empty-transaction proposal resource issue.
partial_findings.title: Malicious proposer can include empty transactions in a valid proposal
